top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 children need emergency contact information for child admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All outdoor equipment observed  have protrusions or openings that can entangle something around a child s neck or a child s clothing.

top_violation_types.title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The classroom walls and window sills had pealing paint. In the Pre-K room one of the walls is stained and dirty. The peeling paint is in the reach of children. The floors in tile floors in the infant rooms are stained and dirty. This is not safe for the children to crawl on.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Sprinkler Play - Equipment and Water Hoses Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.5015(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walk, the hose was on the ground and laid out on the playground where children could access it.
